Career Journey

Syed Masood Hossain studied Electrical & Electronic Engineering at BUET (1979–1983) and later completed a Master of Engineering in Computer Science. He has built a professional career of more than 30 years in the IT sector with major Australian companies, including Telstra, IBM and Fujitsu Australia, where he is a Senior Project Manager. He has also taught part-time with TAFE and is associated with BUET Alumni Australia.

Favorite BUET Memory

My first day at BUET was Physics Lab class and I was in a group with elderly students from Bangladesh Army admitted for studying Engineering. I was bit lost about my existance! Think about what may come to the mind of a boy of about 19 years old only! I felt like “Ami nai”!!
